newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Farmer sales reported slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Farmer sales reported slow.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring were mixed on Thursday with weakness linked to lower MGE futures offset in some areas by slow farmer sales.
Dealers said farmers continued to be generally preoccupied with planting operations although in parts of Montana heavy rains brought fieldwork to a virtual standstill.
"It is raining so hard you can't see across the parking lot," one Montana dealer said. "Planting is stopped for now."
Further east in the Red River Valley, however, conditions were dry and sunny. MGE spring wheat settled 2-1/2 to 7-1/2 cents lower with July down 7-1/4 cents at $4.41-1/2.
